title: Protocol
description: Wire format of Skill-Based Front, generated from gow_protocol.

AckMsg.description:
Result of the command ``seq``: accepted (``reject_code`` is ``None``) or rejected.

``applied_tick``: the tick at whose start the command was validated and, if accepted, applied.
``path``: for an accepted ``move``, the nodes from the group's node to ``dest``; for an
accepted ``transfer`` (DEC-18), the nodes from ``from_node`` to ``to_node`` (the client draws
it and never computes it); ``None`` otherwise.
``arrive_tick``: for an accepted ``move``, the tick the group reaches ``dest`` (planned delay
included; DEC-22, item 10); for an accepted ``transfer``, the tick the charges reach
``to_node``; both if nothing stops them; ``None`` otherwise.
``reject_code``: code of the simulation's ``Reject`` (``NOT_FOUND_OR_HIDDEN``,
``NOT_ENOUGH_CP``, ``QUEUE_FULL``, ... from SIM-04 #20).
AckMsg.title: AckMsg

BuildBarracksCmd.description: The own city ``node`` builds the barracks (DEC-26, ``city_upgrades``): then it recruits.
BuildBarracksCmd.title: BuildBarracksCmd

BuildKind.description: What a city builds (DEC-26, item 9): a road level, the barracks or a warehouse level.
BuildKind.title: BuildKind

BuildPublic.description:
Road upgrades (``build`` of the ruleset, DEC-28, item 7): the price is ``cost.build`` per
level, what a level gives is ``upgrade_gain`` of the own edges in the view.
BuildPublic.title: BuildPublic

Calibration.description:
Calibration progress of an account: the first matches of a rated account do not show its
rating (DEC-34, #414).

total.description: Calibration matches needed (a server setting, 5 by default).

Calibration.title: Calibration

CancelRecruitCmd.description: Take the last unit off the recruit queue of the own city ``node`` (DEC-25, item 11).
CancelRecruitCmd.title: CancelRecruitCmd

CapacityPublic.description: Overcrowding attrition (``capacity`` of the ruleset), for the countdown of ui-style 12.

attrition_ticks.description: Ticks over the capacity in a row before one unit dies.

grace_ticks.description: Ticks after a capture in which the garrison is not counted.

CapacityPublic.title: CapacityPublic

CityUpgradesPublic.description: City development (DEC-26): ``city_upgrades`` and ``warehouse`` of the ruleset.

enabled.description:
Off: every city recruits, the warehouse holds the node capacity, no barracks and no
warehouse levels (the commands are rejected with ``FEATURE_DISABLED``).

CityUpgradesPublic.title: CityUpgradesPublic

planned_bonus_per_edge.description:
Virtual shots of a planned order per edge of its path, at most the charged units of the
group when it departs (DEC-29).

round_ticks.description: Ticks between the rounds of a fight (DEC-24, item B): the round progress of a fight.

regroup_ticks.description: The pause of an edge winner before it goes on (DEC-24, item G4).

seq.description: Client sequence number of the command, strictly increasing; ``ack`` echoes it.

CostsPublic.description: Command costs in hundredths of CP (``orders.cost`` of the ruleset).
CostsPublic.title: CostsPublic

CpPublic.description: CP regeneration: ``per_period`` hundredths every ``period_ticks`` ticks, up to ``cap``.
CpPublic.title: CpPublic

Detail.description:
How much a player sees of a node or a half of an edge (DEC-21, mechanics.md, section 10).

Better first: ``EXACT``, ``RANGE``, ``PRESENCE``, ``FOG``.
Detail.title: Detail

EconomyPublic.description: The charge production the stance menu shows (``economy`` of the ruleset, DEC-02).

charges_per_cp.description: Charges per whole CP put into charges.

EconomyPublic.title: EconomyPublic

EdgeBuild.description: A road level being built on the edge (DEC-28, item 7).

done_tick.description: The tick the level grows; only for an own build.

EdgeBuild.title: EdgeBuild

width.description:
Road level the player knows (DEC-17, DEC-22): the current one unless ``detail`` is
``fog``; in fog the last seen level, or 1 if never seen. Never above the true level.

detail.description:
The road level visibility (DEC-17): ``presence`` while an end is a source of vision or an
own group is on the edge (DEC-10, item 5), else ``fog``. What is seen of enemies is in
``halves`` and ``enemy_groups``.

upgrade_gain.description: Only for own internal edges that can still be upgraded.

halves.description: The half of the end ``a``, then the half of the end ``b`` (DEC-21, item 5).

build.description:
The road level being built here (DEC-28, item 7): an own build always, an enemy one only
while the edge is not in fog (DEC-17, item 5).

enemy_groups.description: Enemy figures on the halves not in fog (DEC-33).

EnemyGroup.description:
An enemy group on a half of an edge not in fog (DEC-33): a figure. A group in a fight is
not one: the fight shows it.

id.description: Opaque, new each time the group comes out of the fog (DEC-33, detail 5).

pos.description: Position in thousandths of the edge from its end ``a`` (detail 1).

toward_b.description: Goes to the end ``b``, else to ``a``: the nearest node, never the target (detail 2).

detail.description: The level of its half: ``exact``, ``range`` or ``presence``.

units_range.description: Only on ``range``: the range of its units.

EnemyGroup.title: EnemyGroup

ErrorMsg.description:
A protocol-level error (malformed message, rate limit, ...); game rejections are ``ack``.

``message`` is a short text for developers. It never echoes the client's input.
ErrorMsg.title: ErrorMsg

EventMsg.description:
A simulation event visible to the player (``gow_sim.state.Event``; PRO-03 filters them).

``data`` mirrors ``Event.data``: flat fields with integer, string, boolean or null values.
Entity ids in ``data`` are opaque ids (strings), map node and edge ids are integers.
EventMsg.title: EventMsg

FightRoundView.description:
The latest round of a fight (DEC-24, item I1 as revised with DEC-29), both players, index
= player id: ``shots`` made (cancelling and killing ones), ``virtual`` among them (bonuses,
terrain), ``spent`` charges that left the player's units, ``losses`` in units. The same
numbers as the ``fight_round`` event of that ``tick``.
FightRoundView.title: FightRoundView

FightView.description:
A fight going on (DEC-24, item I1): a node, or an edge with the meeting ``point``.

``point``: twice the meeting position in thousandths from the end ``a`` of the edge
(0..2000); the mark sits at ``point / 2000`` of the edge from ``a`` (item C3). ``groups``:
the own groups in the fight. ``enemy_units`` and ``enemy_charged``: the enemy's totals in this
fight, exact. A round happens at ``next_round_tick``, every ``combat.round_ticks``.
``shots`` and ``losses``: totals of the fight so far by player; ``last_round``: the latest
round of both players, ``None`` before the first one. ``virtual_left``: the virtual shots
(bonuses, mountains) still left by player, public to both while the fight goes on (DEC-32,
item 3); it grows when a reinforcement with a bonus joins and drops after each round.
``mute``: by player, the charged units in the fight that do not shoot in a round because of
the terrain (plains: one of the defender, DEC-24, item F2), at most the side's charged units.

attacker.description: The player attacking the node; ``None`` on an edge and in a neutral node.

FightView.title: FightView

GroupView.description: An own group. Enemy groups appear only as ``Seen`` summaries of places.

defense_bonus.description:
In Defense (DEC-30): the bonus the group would bring into a fight beginning now, what it
has gathered at most ``defense_cap``; ``None`` in another mode. Enemy groups never have it.

defense_cap.description: In Defense: the cap of its bonus, the charged units of the group (DEC-30, item 2).

GroupView.title: GroupView

HalfView.description: A half of an edge, from its node to the border point (DEC-21, item 5).

detail.description:
The level of the node the half belongs to (a source's half is ``exact``), at least
``presence`` while an own group is on the edge (DEC-10, item 2).

seen.description:
The enemy groups in the half now (those in a fight too) unless ``detail`` is ``fog``; for
``fog`` the last sighting (no positions, DEC-33, detail 8), or ``None``.

HalfView.title: HalfView

HelloMsg.description: First message of a connection. The token is never in the URL, a log or an error text.
HelloMsg.title: HelloMsg

IntentView.description: Public part of a planned order or a mode switch: no group id and no group size.

target.description: ``None`` for an intent without a destination (``defense``).

IntentView.title: IntentView

max_level.description: Highest road level, at most 3 (DEC-23, item 6); every road starts at level 1 (DEC-22).

border_permille.description:
Border point in thousandths from ``a`` (DEC-23, item 5): where the halves of the edge meet
(vision DEC-21, territory on the map).

name.description: Map id: ``map_id`` in ``welcome`` and in the replay header.

version.description: Revision of the map, bumped on every edit.

width.description: World size: coordinates are in ``[0, width] x [0, height]``, ``y`` grows down.

MapMirrorFile.description: Symmetry table: id (as a JSON string key) -> id of the mirrored node or edge.
MapMirrorFile.title: MapMirrorFile

name.description: Name of the node shown by the interface (DEC-23, item 4): not translated.

kind.description: Node kind: its capacity is ``capacity.by_kind`` of the ruleset (DEC-22).

winner.description: ``None`` is a draw: always for ``double_defeat``, possible for ``timer``, else never.

vp.description: Final VP of both players, by player id.

rating.description:
Rating change of the receiving player; ``None``: the match is not rated (DEC-06), or the
player is still in calibration and the rating is hidden (``calibration``). Present when the
match completes the calibration: that is the first rating the player sees (DEC-34).

rated.description:
Whether this match changed your rating (a calibration match did, silently); the final
answer, after the early-resign rule (DEC-34, #414).

calibration.description:
Your calibration progress after this match; ``None`` for a guest, in a match that is not
from the queue, and once calibration was over before this match.

Mode.description: Group mode (mechanics.md, section 3; effects: DEC-08). Roads are built by cities (DEC-16).
Mode.title: Mode

planned.description: Planned order (DEC-08): costlier, visible to everyone as an intent, starts after a delay.

NodeBuilding.description: The current build of an own city, of any kind (DEC-26, item 10).

done_tick.description: The tick it ends, if nothing interrupts it.

NodeBuilding.title: NodeBuilding

NodeKind.description: Kind of a node (DEC-22, item 1; DEC-23, item 1): its capacity is ``capacity.by_kind``.
NodeKind.title: NodeKind

capacity.description: Capacity by the node kind (DEC-22, item 1): public and exact for every node.

warehouse.description:
Charges in the warehouse; only for sources of vision (own nodes, nodes where own groups
stand), never for a neighbour seen by the terrain table (DEC-21, item 3).

seen.description: Current sighting unless ``detail`` is ``fog``; for ``fog`` the last one, or ``None``.

attrition_in.description:
Own node only: ticks until the next unit dies of overcrowding (the garrison exceeds the
capacity and the grace after a capture is over). ``None`` for every other node.

grace_left.description:
Own node only: ticks the grace after a capture still lasts while the garrison exceeds the
capacity. ``None`` for every other node.

starve_in.description:
Own cut-off city only: ticks until its garrison next starves (DEC-19, item 8). ``None``
for every other node.

recruit_queue.description:
Own city only: units in its recruit queue, the one in production included (DEC-25, item
12). ``None`` for provinces, the enemy's and neutral nodes: the enemy's production is hidden.

recruit_progress.description: Own city only: ticks of production of the current unit, up to ``recruit.unit_ticks``.

recruit_waiting.description: Own city only: the current unit is ready and waits for a place (DEC-25, item 7).

has_barracks.description:
Own city: it may recruit (DEC-26: with ``city_upgrades`` the capital and the cities with
the barracks, without it every city). A city of the enemy joined by an edge of the map to any
own node, at any ``detail`` (DEC-31): its barracks are built (``false`` while there are none
or they are being built; no memory). ``None`` for provinces, neutral nodes and the other
cities of the enemy (DEC-26, item 10).

warehouse_level.description: Own city only: warehouse upgrades (DEC-26, item 2; always 0 without ``city_upgrades``).

warehouse_cap.description:
Own city only: charges its warehouse holds (DEC-26, item 2; the node capacity without
``city_upgrades``).

building.description: Own city only: its current build of any kind; ``None`` without one.

OnEdgeLoc.description: Moving along ``edge`` away from ``from_node``; ``progress`` in thousandths.
OnEdgeLoc.title: OnEdgeLoc

OrderView.description: Current order of an own group: the path is the server's, the client never computes it.

bonus.description:
A planned order: the bonus it brings into its first fight (DEC-29: per edge of the path,
at most the charged units of the group). Before the departure a forecast by the charged units
now; the cap is taken in the departure tick. 0 for a normal order and once the bonus entered
a fight. Only own orders exist in a view (owner 2026-10-21, mockup #339).

OrderView.title: OrderView

OrdersPublic.description: Delays of planned orders, the growth of Defense and the stance cooldown (``orders``).

defense_ticks_per_bonus.description:
Defense gains one virtual shot per this many ticks in the mode, at most the charged units
of the group when a fight begins (DEC-30).

OrdersPublic.title: OrdersPublic

PacketView.description:
Own charges on the way along a path of roads (mechanics.md, section 7; DEC-18, item 5).

``edge`` is the current road, travelled away from ``from_node`` during
``depart_tick..arrive_tick``; ``path``: the nodes still to reach, the end of ``edge`` first,
the destination last; ``dest_tick``: the tick it reaches the destination if nothing stops it.
``transfer``: a one-off transfer (DEC-18, item 6), not the automatic dispatch.
PacketView.title: PacketView

PauseMsg.description:
Pause a private match (DEC-05): one pause per player, at most ``paused.ends_in_s`` long.

Refused with ``error`` ``PAUSE_DENIED`` in a rated match, with no pause left or while paused.
PauseMsg.title: PauseMsg

PausedMsg.description: The pause state of the match changed (also sent after ``welcome`` while paused).

by.description: Player who paused; ``None`` when ``paused`` is false.

ends_in_s.description: Whole seconds until the pause ends by itself; ``None`` when ``paused`` is false.

PausedMsg.title: PausedMsg

PingMsg.description: Application-level ping for RTT (browsers do not expose protocol pings).

id.description: Echoed in ``pong``; the client measures the time itself.

PingMsg.title: PingMsg

RatingChange.description:
The rating of the receiving player before and after a rated match (RAT-02, #75).

Both numbers are the displayed rating (``r - 2 * RD``, RAT-01), rounded to integers.
RatingChange.title: RatingChange

ReachMsg.description:
Answer to ``reach_query``, computed by the server on the state after tick ``tick``
(DEC-20, D5; DEC-22, item 10). The client highlights ``nodes``, shows their travel time and
suggests splitting the group for ``split``; it computes neither. Both lists are empty for a
group that is unknown, not own, hidden or on an edge.

nodes.description: Nodes a ``move`` of the group is accepted to now, by node id.

split.description: Nodes a ``move`` is rejected to with ``STACK_LIMIT``: only a smaller group gets there.

ReachMsg.title: ReachMsg

ticks.description: Ticks of the path once the group departs (a planned order waits its delay first).

path.description:
The nodes from the group's node to ``node``: the path ``ticks`` refers to, the same one
the ``ack`` of a ``move`` there carries (#448). All but the last are the group's node or own
nodes.

ReachQueryMsg.description:
Ask where an own standing group can be ordered to and how long it takes (DEC-20, D5).

The answer is ``reach``. The interface sends it when a group is selected; the connection's
message rate limit covers it like every other message.
ReachQueryMsg.title: ReachQueryMsg

RecruitCmd.description: Put one unit into the recruit queue of the own city ``node`` (DEC-25).
RecruitCmd.title: RecruitCmd

RecruitPublic.description: The recruit queue of a city (``recruit`` of the ruleset, DEC-25).

unit_ticks.description: Ticks of production per unit: the full progress of the current unit.

queue_max.description: Units in the queue of one city at most, the one in production included.

refund_started_pct.description:
Share of ``cost.recruit`` a cancel returns for the unit in production; a unit not started
yet returns all of it.

RecruitPublic.title: RecruitPublic

ResumeMsg.description: End a pause early. Only the player who paused may; else ``error`` ``PAUSE_DENIED``.
ResumeMsg.title: ResumeMsg

ResyncMsg.description: Ask for a full snapshot now (after a gap in snapshots).
ResyncMsg.title: ResyncMsg

Seen.description:
What the player sees, or last saw, of one node or half of an edge
(``gow_sim.state.Sighting``).

``enemy_modes``: distinct modes of the enemy groups there; empty means no enemy groups.
``enemy_units`` and ``enemy_charged`` are totals, present only when ``level`` is ``exact``;
``enemy_range``: the range of the total units, only when ``level`` is ``range`` and enemies
are there. ``level`` is never ``fog``: a place in fog is not seen, it keeps an older ``Seen``.
Seen.title: Seen

SelfView.description: Own counters; the enemy's CP and stance are never in a view (AGENTS.md, section 4.4).

fronts.description:
The own cities of the front markers (DEC-28, item 2; ``supply.front_markers`` of
``ruleset_public``), ``null``: not placed. The enemy's markers are never in a view.

rear_min.description: The own rear minimum (DEC-28, item 3); the enemy's is never in a view.

SelfView.title: SelfView

SetFrontCmd.description:
Put the front marker ``marker`` (``0..supply.front_markers - 1`` of ``ruleset_public``,
checked by the simulation) on the own city ``node``; ``node = null`` takes it off the map
(DEC-28, item 2). Free (``cost.front``).
SetFrontCmd.title: SetFrontCmd

SetRearMinCmd.description:
The own rear minimum ``n``, ``0..supply.rear_min_max`` of ``ruleset_public`` (DEC-28,
item 3); the range is checked by the simulation (``INVALID_ARGUMENT``).
SetRearMinCmd.title: SetRearMinCmd

SnapshotMsg.description: The player's view after tick ``tick``. Only the latest one matters (AGENTS.md, 5.3).
SnapshotMsg.title: SnapshotMsg

n.description: Units that leave ``group`` as a new group.

Stance.description: CP stance: the share of CP regeneration that goes into charges (DEC-02).
Stance.title: Stance

StancePctPublic.description: ``economy.stance_to_charges_pct``: the share of the CP quantum put into charges, in %.
StancePctPublic.title: StancePctPublic

SupplyPublic.description: The supply settings of a player (DEC-28): the range of the rear minimum slider.

rear_min_default.description: The rear minimum every player starts with.

front_markers.description: Front markers of a player: ``set_front`` accepts ``marker`` ``0..front_markers - 1``.

SupplyPublic.title: SupplyPublic

TerrainDefensePublic.description: ``terrain.defense_mod``: charges added to the node defender's pool; may be negative.
TerrainDefensePublic.title: TerrainDefensePublic

TransferCmd.description:
Ship ``n`` charges from the warehouse of the own city ``from_node`` to the own city
``to_node`` along own roads, once (DEC-18, item 6). The ``ack`` carries the path and the
arrival tick; the client never computes them.
TransferCmd.title: TransferCmd

UnitsRange.description:
A range of units (DEC-21, item 4; ``vision.range_starts``): ``low..high``, ``high``
``null`` for the last, open range («21+»).
UnitsRange.title: UnitsRange

UnratedReason.description: Why a match did not change your rating (DEC-34, #414).
UnratedReason.title: UnratedReason

UpgradeGain.description: What the next road level would give (DEC-28, item 7).

speed_pct.description: Packet speed gain in percentage points.

unit_speed_pct.description: Unit speed gain in percentage points (``road.speed_pct``).

amount.description: Gain of charges per dispatch period (``supply.amount_by_level``).

UpgradeGain.title: UpgradeGain

UpgradeRoadCmd.description:
Raise the own internal road ``edge`` by one level for ``cost.build`` CP (DEC-28, item 7);
no city pays or builds it.
UpgradeRoadCmd.title: UpgradeRoadCmd

UpgradeWarehouseCmd.description: The own city ``node`` raises its warehouse by one level (DEC-26, item 3).
UpgradeWarehouseCmd.title: UpgradeWarehouseCmd

vp.description: VP of both players, by player id; public (DEC-04).

nodes.description: Every node of the map, ``nodes[i].id == i``.

edges.description: Every edge of the map, ``edges[i].id == i``.

fights.description: Fights going on (DEC-24): own groups fight in each.

WelcomeMsg.description: Answer to a valid ``hello``, also after a reconnect; a full ``snapshot`` follows.

map_id.description: The map graph itself is public and comes over HTTP (``GET /api/maps/{id}``).

last_seq.description:
Highest ``seq`` of this player the server has accepted; ``0`` if none. After a reconnect
the client resends only its commands with a greater ``seq``.

nicks.description:
Nicks of the two players by player id (ui-style U3); the bot of a bot match is ``Bot``.
Not secret (visible in the waiting room and the queue), so not part of the ``PlayerView``.

rated.description:
Whether this match is expected to change your rating (DEC-34, #414); a calibration match
does, silently. A rated match can still end unrated for its winner (an early resign of the
opponent): ``match_end`` has the final answer.

unrated_reason.description: Why not (``rated`` is ``False``), known at the start; ``None`` when ``rated``.

calibration.description:
Your calibration progress before this match; ``None`` for a guest, in a match that is not
from the queue, and once calibration is over.

pause_available.description:
Whether you may still pause this match (DEC-05): ``False`` in a rated (queue) match and
once you have used your pause, also on a reconnect. A pause of the opponent going on now
does not change it (``paused`` says that).

WelcomeMsg.title: WelcomeMsg
